name: Dlf City Gurgaon
shortDescription: DLF City, Gurugram is a premium and well-established residential destination known for its prime location.
longDescription:
DLF City, Gurugram is one of the most established and sought-after residential destinations in Gurugram, Haryana. Spread across multiple phases, DLF City offers a well-planned urban environment with excellent connectivity to major business districts, Golf Course Road, MG Road, NH-48, Cyber City, and Delhi.

The locality features a diverse range of residential properties, including luxury builder floors, independent houses, villas, apartments, and premium residences, making it suitable for both families and investors. Residents benefit from easy access to reputed schools, hospitals, shopping centres, restaurants, entertainment destinations, and everyday conveniences.

With its mature infrastructure, prime location, established neighbourhood, and strong real-estate demand, DLF City remains an important residential and property market in Gurugram. It is a preferred location for those looking to buy, sell, or rent premium residential properties in Gurgaon.
